I {{executorName}}, a {{executorOcuupation}}, of {{executorAddress}} the personal representatives of {{deceasedName}} of {{deceasedAddress}}, who died on {{dateOFDeath}} and whose WILL was proved by me on the {{date}}, in the Probate Registry of the High Court of {{state}}, where the probate was granted to us.

Do Hereby as personal representatives, on this {{date}} :

ASSENT to the vesting on {{purchaserName}} a {{purchaserOccupation}}, of {{purchaserAddress}} , ALL THAT {{propertyDescription}} situate {{propertyAddress}}, for all the estate and interest in it existing at the time of the death of the deceased.

The beneficiary covenants with the personal representatives, that he will;
1. Perform and observe any restrictive covenants and conditions to which the property is subject.
2. Compensate the personal representatives and each of them and the estate of the deceased in full for any liability on them.

AND we acknowledge the rights of {{purchaserName}}, to the production of the will and probate of the deceased and to deliver copies thereof.

AND WE DECLARE that we have not previously given or made any assent or conveyance in respect of any legal estate in the premises or any part of it.

IN WITNESS OF WHICH I {{executorName}} have set our respective hands and seal here.

SIGNED, SEALED AND DELIVERED:

By the within named Personal Representative

______________
{{executorName}}
